# SODAQ Notice

The original demo bundle included SODAQ Arduino libraries and examples:

- `Sodaq_nbIOT`
- `Sodaq_wdt`
- SODAQ NB-IoT sensor examples

Original upstream references:

- https://github.com/SodaqMoja/Sodaq_nbIOT
- https://github.com/SodaqMoja/Sodaq_wdt

The historical SODAQ source headers indicate LGPL/GPL-family licensing depending on component. This public repository's new SDK code is Apache-2.0, while any future vendored SODAQ code must retain its original notices and license terms.
